claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held in 2026.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the Oscar for Best Cinematography for her work on Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman to win the Oscar for Best Cinematography.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman of color to be recognized in the Best Cinematography Oscar category.
Rachel Morrison (2018), Ari Wegner (2022), Mandy Walker (2023), and Autumn Durald Arkapaw (2026).
Rachel Morrison was the first woman ever nominated for Best Cinematography for Mudbound (2018).
Ari Wegner was nominated for Best Cinematography for The Power of the Dog (2022).
Mandy Walker was nominated for Best Cinematography for Elvis (2023).
Before 2018, no woman had ever been nominated for the Best Cinematography Oscar.
